properties.title: View distance
properties.detail: 12 is above the usual 6–10 range for modded dedicated servers. Higher view-distance loads more chunks per player — often the first place modded servers cut lag.

properties.title: Simulation distance
properties.detail: Simulation distance 8 is in the usual range for modded dedicated servers.

properties.title: Max tick time
properties.detail: max-tick-time 60000ms gives the server room before a watchdog kill.

properties.title: Network compression
properties.detail: Compression threshold 256 is in a common range.

properties.title: Sync chunk writes
properties.detail: sync-chunk-writes is true. Consider setting false on dedicated servers to reduce stutter from synchronous disk flushes.

properties.title: Entity broadcast range
properties.detail: Entity broadcast 100% is in a common range.

jvm.advice: Worth adding missing flags from the Aikar / flags.sh baseline.
